subject: Startups
title: Fintech Regulation
description: Learn Fintech Regulation in one minute.

hook.text: Stripe made accepting payments online easy. Behind that simplicity hides an enormous web of financial regulations.

buildup.text: Fintech startups must navigate KYC, AML, money transmission laws, PCI compliance, and banking charter requirements.

discovery.text: Getting a banking charter takes years. Most fintechs partner with chartered banks instead, renting their compliance.

twist.text: When crypto exploded, regulators were caught off guard.

climax.text: Fintech winners are those who turn compliance into a competitive advantage.

punchline.text: In fintech, regulation is the product. Master it or fail.

quiz.question: Why do most fintechs partner with chartered banks?
options: Getting their own banking charter takes years
